status.main_product: Trade finance and working capital technology platform
status.scope_reason: The company operates a blockchain-enabled marketplace and software platform specifically designed for digitizing, automating, and distributing trade finance and supply chain finance assets.
status.evidence: LiquidX is an active global fintech platform processing billions in trade finance transactions, with its largest strategic investor being Broadridge Financial Solutions according to an official company profile up to 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports that clients can transact across supply chain finance (SCF), accounts receivable (AR), payables, inventory finance, dynamic discounting, and trade credit insurance in one place via its unified software platform.

The company reports offering its "Digitize" solution to ingest and process unstructured trade data from any format, enabling SMEs to issue digital bills of trade without forcing counterparty onboarding onto a single closed network.
claims.corrected: The company reports offering its "Digitize" solution to ingest and process unstructured trade data from any format, enabling SMEs to issue digital bills of exchange without forcing counterparty onboarding onto a single closed network.

claims.claim: The company reports that its digitization technology leverages Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) via Hyperledger Fabric to convert purchase orders, invoices, and insurance documents into smart contracts. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed further details.

The company reports that its modular platform has processed over $120 billion in trade finance transactions since 2016, with annual trade volumes reaching $27.2 billion in 2025 according to the LiquidX Growth Report.

The company reports that its trade finance solutions are delivered via a Software-as-a-Service model and support automated data connectivity through direct API integration according to Global Trade Review.
claims.note: Software-as-a-Service model and automated data connectivity through direct API integration according to Global Trade Review

claims.claim: The company published its software roadmap direction in June 2026 highlighting its evolution to a global trade finance SaaS solution for financial institutions, covering embedded working capital and risk management expansion within its TradeHub platform.
claims.source: LiquidX Blog (June 10, 2026: 'LiquidX's Evolution to a Global Trade Finance Solution to FIs')

claims.claim: Huntington National Bank selected LiquidX in November 2022 to provide an automated, end-to-end back-office solution to scale its trade finance infrastructure.
claims.corrected: Huntington National Bank selected LiquidX in November 2022 to provide an automated, end-to-end back-office solution to scale its trade finance infrastructure.
claims.note: The original claim was factually accurate but flagged 'incorrect' under strict verification rules if the source date says November 1, 2022, which is November 2022. Actually, it is fully correct.

claims.claim: Truist Financial Corporation and Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank leveraged LiquidX's white-label technology and distribution capabilities, as confirmed in 2024 announcements.
claims.source: LiquidX Case Studies & Press Releases (Truist: June 7, 2024; Crédit Agricole: October 3, 2024)

claims.claim: U.S. Bank entered into a collaboration agreement with LiquidX in May 2022 to streamline supply-chain-finance friction and transactions between suppliers and buyers.
The company reports that its total annual trade volume reached $27.2 billion in 2025, up from $25.1 billion in 2024, representing an 8% year-over-year increase.
claims.source: LiquidX Blog (March 5, 2026: 'Asset managers and 2026 trade finance growth')

claims.claim: The company reports that it has processed over $134 billion in trade finance transactions for global and regional banks and asset managers across fiscal year 2025 and H1 2026.
claims.note: The metrics specifying '$134 billion' processed across 'fiscal year 2025 and H1 2026' could not be verified in published corporate records.

claims.claim: Following a strategic software pivot executed in 2022 and 2023, the company closed its previously established international offices in London and Singapore.

Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. entered into a strategic investment and multi-year alliance with LiquidX, Inc. in March 2016, and expanded its relationship in November 2020 to become the company's largest strategic investor.
LiquidX, Inc. announced a strategic investment from Citi in June 2022, in a funding round that was led by its largest strategic investor, Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.

The company reports processing over $134 billion in trade finance transactions since inception, with total annual trade volumes reaching $27.2 billion in 2025 (up from $25.1 billion in 2024) and $14.3 billion processed in the first half of 2026.
claims.note: The volume details of '$134 billion since inception', '$27.2 billion in 2025', '$25.1 billion in 2024', and '$14.3 billion in H1 2026' could not be confirmed.
claims.source: LiquidX Official Blog and Press Releases (https://www.liquidx.com/newsroom/)

claims.claim: The company reports its digital network connects more than 100 banks and asset managers, featuring clients such as U.S. Bank, NORD/LB, Crédit Agricole Group, and Truist.
